description_en: Converts the billing method of an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance from pay-as-you-go to subscription, or from subscription to pay-as-you-go
description_zh: 转换云数据库MongoDB实例的付费类型，将按量付费（后付费）实例转换为包年包月（预付费）实例或者包年包月实例转换为按量付费实例
name: TransformInstanceChargeType

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration. Valid values:

If PricingCycle is set to Month: 1 to 9.

If PricingCycle is set to Year: 1, 2, 3, and 5
parameters.help_zh:
预付费时长，取值范围为：

当PricingCycle单位为Month:1~9

当PricingCycle单位为Year: 1、2、3、5
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the order is automatically paid. Valid values:

true: The order is automatically paid.
false: The order is manually paid.

Default value: true
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动支付订单，取值说明：

true：自动支付订单。
false：手动支付订单。

默认值为true
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal upon expiration. Valid values:

true: enables auto-renewal.
false: disables auto-renewal.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
到期后是否自动续费，取值说明：

true：自动续费。
false：手动续费。

默认值为false
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use a coupon. Valid values:
default or null (default): uses a coupon.
youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank: does not use a coupon
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用优惠券，取值说明：
default或null（默认）：使用优惠券。
youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank：不使用优惠券
parameters.name: coupon_no

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:
PrePaid: subscription.
PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
实例付费类型，取值说明：
PrePaid：预付费，包年包月。
PostPaid：按量付费
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the subscription duration. Valid values:
Month: month.
Year: year.

Default value: Month
parameters.help_zh:
实例付费时长单位
取值说明：
Month： 月
Year： 年

默认值：Month
parameters.name: pricing_cycle

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符，且该参数值中不能包含非 ASCII 字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the request. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without calling the operation. The system checks the request parameters, request format, service limits, and available resources. If the request fails the dry run, the system returns an error. If the request passes the dry run, the system returns the DryRunOperation error code.
false (default): sends the request. If the request passes the dry run, the system performs the operation
parameters.help_zh:
是否对本次请求执行预检查，取值：
true：执行预检查，不真正调用该接口。检查项包含请求参数、请求格式、业务限制和库存等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误；如果检查通过，则返回错误码 DryRunOperation。
false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接执行本次操作
parameters.name: dry_run
